stem:
Javed faces a plane mirror and raises his right hand.

How does the raised hand appear in the mirror?

options.text: as the left hand, raised on the opposite side
as the right hand, with no change of side
it does not appear in the mirror

teacher.key_rationale: A plane mirror laterally inverts left and right, so a raised right hand appears as a raised left hand. No side change omits inversion. Downward substitutes vertical flip for lateral inversion.

mx_swap.reason: Photograph/right-arm CWO invents a photograph not in the stem; kept term_substitution and condition_omission on the hand-raise hinge.
